headline: K.M. Sugar Mills Limited files Scheme of Arrangement with NSE
sum: K.M. Sugar Mills Limited has filed a Scheme of Arrangement, signalling a potential corporate restructuring or merger/demerger; the scheme was disclosed to the NSE under Regulation 30 (continuous disclosure requirements).
implication: Scheme of Arrangement filings trigger NCLT jurisdiction and shareholder approval gating; confirm whether this is an intra-group restructure (faster IBC-exempt route) or a third-party M&A requiring full Chapter X review.
detail: K.M. Sugar Mills Limited, a sugar manufacturer, has informed the NSE of a Scheme of Arrangement via a Regulation 30 disclosure. The filing does not yet specify the counterparty, consideration, or whether the scheme involves a merger, demerger, or internal reorganisation. A Scheme of Arrangement under the Companies Act requires NCLT sanction in India and typically involves shareholder voting. The NSE filing marks formal disclosure to the market.
